tool_args.rationale: The nine observations support a smooth, concave input response suppressed by gradient. Fit and leave-one-out selection compare compact saturating sink variants numerically; fresh confirmation is needed to establish whether the selected mechanism meets the requested tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A substrate-only law cannot explain the observed gradient dependence.
A single gradient power does not naturally represent a finite response at low gradient or a saturating sink.
The paid observations are below the recalled threshold, so an avalanche coefficient is not identifiable from them.
Both relevant listed probes have already been acquired; the nuisance probe is unrelated.
